abilities.name: Create images with fal.ai
abilities.author: KIQR
abilities.summary: Photos and illustrations from a text prompt. About $0.03 per image.

abilities.name: Create images with OpenAI
abilities.author: KIQR
abilities.summary: Images from a prompt with gpt-image-1. About $0.04 to $0.17 per image.

abilities.name: Send email from your mail account
abilities.author: KIQR
abilities.summary: Email over SMTP: Gmail with an app password, Fastmail, Outlook or any mail host. Each project connects its own account. Every send asks you first.

abilities.name: Publish articles to WordPress
abilities.author: KIQR
abilities.summary: Articles from the library become WordPress posts, as drafts unless you say otherwise. Each project connects its own site.

abilities.name: Read Google Analytics
abilities.author: KIQR
abilities.summary: Sessions, users, page views, organic sessions and key events from a GA4 property, once a day into Performance. Needs a service account added as a viewer on the property.

auth.label: GA4 property id
auth.help: The number under Admin → Property settings, e.g. 123456789

auth.label: Service account key file
auth.help: Path on this machine to the JSON key of a service account that is a Viewer on the property

abilities.name: Read Google Search Console
abilities.author: KIQR
abilities.summary: Clicks, impressions, click-through rate and average position per day, with the top queries and pages, once a day into Performance. Needs the service account added as a user on the property.

auth.label: Search Console property
auth.help: sc-domain:example.com for a domain property, or the exact URL for a URL-prefix property

auth.label: Service account key file
auth.help: Path on this machine to the JSON key of a service account added as a user on the property

abilities.name: Read Plausible Analytics
abilities.author: KIQR
abilities.summary: Visitors, visits and page views per day from Plausible, hosted or self-hosted, once a day into Performance.

auth.label: Site
auth.help: The domain as Plausible shows it, e.g. example.com

auth.label: Host
auth.help: Only for self-hosted Plausible, e.g. https://plausible.example.com
